solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Commanded to appear at court?

parts.note: a person ordered by a writ to attend a hearing has been called before the judge; the question mark admits a royal court reading too

explanation.surface: Someone was ordered to turn up before a judge.
explanation.definitionFit: Being called by official writ to attend a court hearing is exactly what this legal past participle describes.

clue.text: Naive politician caught in a web of lies

indicators.note: the politician is trapped inside the tangled letters, as a fly is caught in a web
a web is a tangle, so the letters of lies are woven into a new order

parts.note: MP, Member of Parliament, is the standard abbreviation for a politician

explanation.surface: A gullible politician gets trapped by their own tangle of falsehoods.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a web of' rearranges the letters of lies into SILE before the politician is caught inside; 'web of lies' reads as an idiom, not a signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a naive person is unsophisticated and artless, which is the plain, guileless sense here.

clue.text: Thought broadcast item dated

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters of item dated are sown in a new order

explanation.surface: A radio item was judged to be out of date.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' rearranges the letters of ITEM DATED.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to meditate is to reflect or ponder, so this past tense matches the verb sense of thought.

clue.text: Forgets it is shortly on order

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece written on another sits after it, so this piece follows

parts.note: OM is the Order of Merit, a British honour
it is shortened by contraction gives the apostrophised form, written without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: Somebody neglects tasks even though they are about to be ordered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shortly' signals the contraction IT'S; OM is the Order of Merit, a British award.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone who forgets something leaves it out, which is the sense of skipping or neglecting it.

clue.text: It provides no latitude for the navigator

definitions.text: It provides no latitude for the navigator

parts.words: It provides no latitude for the navigator
parts.note: the great circle at zero degrees gives no latitude at all, playing on latitude as freedom

explanation.surface: Something leaves a ship's officer no room for manoeuvre.
explanation.definitionFit: The line round the Earth's middle is defined as zero degrees of latitude, so it gives none.

clue.text: Our flow of capital

parts.note: the river running through London, Britain's capital, posing as a financial phrase about money flows

explanation.surface: A financial paper speaks of national investment flows.
explanation.walkthrough: The THAMES is the river flowing through London; in the FT the phrase looks like talk of money.
explanation.definitionFit: The river that flows through London is the waterway running through the British capital.

clue.text: One may be entranced by his performance

definitions.text: One may be entranced by his performance

parts.words: One may be entranced by his performance
parts.note: entranced means put into a trance, not merely delighted, by a stage act

explanation.surface: A spectator is charmed by an entertainer's show.
explanation.definitionFit: This performer puts subjects into a trance, so audience members are literally entranced by the act.

clue.text: Revolutionary article found in the market

indicators.note: the article is located inside the word for market

parts.note: a mart is a market or trading place
A is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A radical political pamphlet turns up on a market stall.
explanation.walkthrough: MARAT was Jean-Paul Marat, a leader of the French Revolution.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Jean-Paul Marat was a famous radical of the French Revolution, murdered in his bath.

clue.text: Body-builders stride so energetically

indicators.note: moving energetically jumbles the letters of stride and so into a new order

explanation.surface: Muscular gym-goers march about with great vigour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'energetically' rearranges STRIDE and SO.
explanation.definitionFit: Synthetic hormones that build muscle are body-builders in a chemical sense, not people.

clue.text: Fabricated some story and ended the argument

definitions.meaning: to invent a tale is to concoct it from nothing
to settle a quarrel is to be reconciled after it

explanation.surface: Someone told a lie and then brought a quarrel to a close.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both invented a falsehood and became reconciled after a falling-out.

clue.text: Not much of a press, perhaps

indicators.note: perhaps hints the letters of a press might be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: A small printing operation produces only a little output.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges A PRESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something thin and scanty is not much in quantity.

clue.text: Help and applause for the worker

definitions.meaning: to give someone assistance is to lend them a helping one
a big round of clapping, as in give her a big one

explanation.surface: A labourer receives assistance and a round of clapping.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means assistance, a round of clapping, and a manual labourer, all familiar senses.

clue.text: Water-lily collection going to America

indicators.note: the first piece goes on to the second, so they sit side by side in that order

parts.note: a lot is a collection or batch, as at an auction
US is the United States of America

explanation.surface: A batch of exotic pond plants is being shipped to the States.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: this sacred Asian aquatic plant is a kind of water-lily.

clue.text: Far too wet to go out, settle for this instead

indicators.note: going out disturbs the letters of far too wet, sending them into new positions

explanation.surface: The weather is too rainy for a trip, so stay in with a cuppa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to go out' rearranges FAR TOO WET. Tea for two is a cosy pot shared at home, and the title of a popular song.
explanation.definitionFit: A pot shared by a couple indoors is the comfortable alternative when rain keeps you home.

clue.text: He attacks the copper with acid

definitions.text: He attacks the copper with acid

parts.words: He attacks the copper with acid
parts.note: an engraver bites a copper plate with acid to make prints, not someone assaulting a policeman

explanation.surface: A thug throws acid at a policeman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'copper' is British slang for a policeman, which is the misleading reading.
explanation.definitionFit: A printmaker who uses acid to bite designs into a metal plate does exactly this.

clue.text: Was not keen to take exam without being warmed up

indicators.note: without here means outside, so the warmed-up word surrounds the exam word

parts.note: heated means warmed up
to sit an exam is to take it

explanation.surface: A student was reluctant to face a test without first warming up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, so it works as a container signal rather than meaning lacking.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone who hung back from acting was reluctant, which is being not keen.

clue.text: Being raised, either way

indicators.note: either way means the word reads the same from both ends

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Something is being lifted up, whichever direction you look at it.
explanation.definitionFit: Being raised to the status of a god is to be made divine, a lofty sense of raised.

clue.text: One Asian country with units in another

indicators.note: the units are placed inside the other country

parts.note: another Asian country, here India
ones are units in counting

explanation.surface: One Asian nation has military units stationed in a neighbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: this archipelago nation in South-East Asia is an Asian country.

clue.text: One blow after another makes great entertainment

parts.note: a smash is a heavy blow
another blow, here a hit

explanation.surface: A boxing match with blow after blow is a wonderful show.
explanation.definitionFit: A hugely successful show or record is great entertainment, the showbiz sense of a smash.

clue.text: Reserve an enclosure, after a fashion

indicators.note: the enclosure comes after the fashion word in the answer

parts.note: mode means a fashion or style
a sty is an enclosure for pigs

explanation.surface: Someone books a pen, in a manner of speaking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reserve' looks like a verb meaning book; it is the noun meaning restraint.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: reserve in the sense of reticence or restraint is self-effacing humility.

clue.text: Yes, truly an aspiration

parts.note: yea is an old word for truly or indeed
the letter H is pronounced as a breathy aspirate

explanation.surface: Someone says yes with real hope.
explanation.walkthrough: H is called an aspirate because it is sounded as a breath.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal synonym: this casual word is a relaxed way of saying yes.

clue.text: Slovenly in duty, has to be removed

indicators.note: removed is read as re-moved, so the letters of in duty are moved again

explanation.surface: A sloppy worker on the job must be sacked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'removed' rearranges IN DUTY; 'has to be' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a slovenly person or room is messy and disorderly.

clue.text: Shun ale that distributed free

indicators.note: distributed means shared out, so the letters of shun and ale are dealt into a new order

explanation.surface: Avoid beer that has been handed out at no charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distributed' rearranges SHUN and ALE.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to set free, as a dog from its lead, is to let it loose.

clue.text: Unfriendly country, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals that the country's name is spoken, giving a word of the same sound

parts.note: Chile is a South American country

explanation.surface: A nation's reception sounds rather cold.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a chilly welcome is cold and unfriendly.

clue.text: Not enough money even for a brief trip

parts.note: short means brief
a trip is a stumble or fall

explanation.surface: Even a short holiday costs more than you can afford.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trip' reads as a journey, but here it is a stumble.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a deficit of funds is an amount by which money falls below what is needed.

clue.text: Like an egg — so veto a pie

indicators.note: pie is printers' jargon for jumbled type, so the letters of veto a are mixed up

explanation.surface: Someone rejects a pastry as egg-shaped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pie' is old printers' slang for spilled, jumbled type, so it rearranges VETO A.
explanation.definitionFit: This botanical word means egg-shaped, from the Latin for an egg.

clue.text: You can put it on a horse that's a sure thing

definitions.text: You can put it on a horse
definitions.meaning: a saddle girth fastened round a horse's belly
something certain or easy, a dead certainty

explanation.surface: A gambler is told a horse is a certain winner.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a saddle girth strapped on a horse and an easy certainty.

clue.text: Singers in church set up the port

indicators.note: in a down clue, set up means the word is lifted to read from bottom to top

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro, the Brazilian port, is often shortened to Rio

explanation.surface: Church singers are establishing themselves in a harbour town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set up' is a down-clue reversal, so the port reads upwards as OIR; 'in' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a choir is a group of singers, often in a church.

clue.text: He has the skills to make a suit

parts.note: taken as written
arts are skills or crafts

explanation.surface: A tailor is skilled enough to make a suit of clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suit' reads as clothing, but it is a suit of playing cards.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: one of the four suits in a deck of playing cards.

clue.text: Girl secures employment in musical

indicators.note: the girl's name holds the employment word inside it

parts.note: Carol is a girl's name
use means employment, as in putting to use

explanation.surface: A young woman lands a job in a stage show.
explanation.walkthrough: CAROUSEL is a Rodgers and Hammerstein musical.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a Rodgers and Hammerstein stage show first produced in 1945.

clue.text: With it, essay is without conclusion

indicators.note: without here means outside, so the essay word goes round the conclusion word

parts.note: an essay is an attempt, a try
an end is a conclusion

explanation.surface: A fashionable essay lacks a proper ending.
explanation.walkthrough: 'essay' means an attempt, not a piece of writing, and 'without' takes its old sense of outside rather than lacking.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: being with it means fashionable and up to date.

clue.text: Abuse found in rapid dispensing of drugs

indicators.note: the abuse word is located inside the rapid word

parts.note: pacy means fast or rapid
to abuse is to harm, here as a noun

explanation.surface: Drug misuse turns up in rushed prescriptions.
explanation.definitionFit: Pharmacy is the practice of preparing and dispensing medicinal drugs.
